name: regreview
description: AI pre-inspection review for FDA-regulated design and quality records

scripts.//: Workspaces import @regreview/core via its dist output, so core is built first. tsc -b is incremental, so this is a no-op once warm.
scripts.//review: Run from the repo root so --env-file-if-exists finds ./.env and the CLI's relative imports resolve. --env-file-if-exists (not --env-file) so a missing .env is not an error.
scripts.ingest:observations: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/corpus ingest:observations
scripts.ingest:cfr: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/corpus ingest:cfr
scripts.ingest:guidance: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/corpus ingest:guidance
scripts.ingest:rules: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/corpus ingest:rules
scripts.corpus:report: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/corpus report
scripts.severity:check: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/corpus severity:check
scripts.eval: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/eval eval
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/server dev
scripts.diff:runs: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/corpus diff:runs
scripts.rules:report: npm run build:core && npm run -w @regreview/corpus rules:report
